rows.headline: KFintech handles Mahanadi Coalfields IPO; allotment completed
rows.summary: Refunds and demat credits for the Mahanadi Coalfields IPO, where KFintech is registrar, began on 26 November. The company was recently fined ₹10 lakh by SEBI over share-processing issues.

rows.headline: US core PCE inflation 3.3% in October, above the 3.2% expected
rows.summary: Headline PCE rose to 3.8%. The report makes a quarter-point Fed rate rise on 9 December look all but certain, a headwind for silver and gold.
